content:
**Evasive** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increases Evade chance based on Agility. Does not work when overencumbered or in power armor. Stacks additively with other evade chance bonuses.

| ![Evasive Bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/2/2e/Evasive_Bonus.png) | | 
| | Agility | Evade | 
| | 1 | +2% | 
| | 15 | +6% | 
| | 30 | +9% | 
| | 60 | +12% | 
| | 100 | +14% | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Chance to Evade attacks based on AGI. (No Power Armor) | 00323F83 | 

The perk was reduced from three ranks to one in Update 56. The prior version of the perk appears below:

| Rank | Description | Editor ID | Form ID | 
| 1 | Each AGI point adds +1 Damage and Energy Resist (Max 15). (No Power Armor) | Evasive01 | 00323F83 | 
| 2 | Each AGI point adds +2 Damage and Energy Resist (Max 30). (No Power Armor) | Evasive02 | 00323F85 | 
| 3 | Each AGI point adds +3 Damage and Energy Resist (Max 45). (No Power Armor) | Evasive03 | 00323F86 |
